GoalFixtureWindowRequest.description: Synthetic input only behind the verified deployment fixture gate. The service checks window_start < window_end, window_end no more than 5 seconds in the future, window duration at most 24 hours, window_end < expires_at <= window_end + 1 hour, current freshness, exact group scope, unique message ids and each message at within the window. Invalid/expired windows cannot advance the run; waiting reason is durable. Schema checks shape and character bounds; the service checks byte limits and temporal relationships.
